---
name: repo-code-risk-reviewer
description: "Review Python files in this repository for broken or high-risk lines, explain why each issue is flagged, and recommend how to fix it."
---

Use this prompt when you want the `repo-code-risk-reviewer` agent to inspect Python source files and provide actionable code review comments.

Example prompts:
- "Review `locallama_gui/ui/main_window.py` for broken or risky lines."
- "Analyze the repo and flag unsafe Python patterns in `locallama_gui/backends/ollama.py`."
- "Comment on any high-risk or broken code in the Python backend."
